expected_score =: 3 : 0
    'home away advantage' =. y
    1%1+10^((away-home)-advantage)%400
)
run_elo =: 4 : 0
    'coefficient advantage initial' =. x
    ratings =. TeamCount$initial+0.0
    expected =. changes =. 0$0.0
    snapshots =. 0$a:
    for_index. i.#y do.
        'round home away first second' =. index{y
        homerat =. home{ratings
        awayrat =. away{ratings
        probability =. expected_score homerat,awayrat,advantage
        margin =. first-second
        multiplier =. 1.0
        if. margin~:0 do.
            if. margin>0 do. difference =. (homerat+advantage)-awayrat
            else. difference =. (awayrat-homerat)-advantage end.
            multiplier =. ((^.1+|margin)*2.2)%2.2+0.001*difference
        end.
        result =. (match_result index{y)%2
        change =. (coefficient*multiplier)*(result-probability)
        ratings =. (homerat+change)home}ratings
        ratings =. (awayrat-change)away}ratings
        expected =. expected,probability
        changes =. changes,change
        last =. index=(#y)-1
        if. -.last do. last =. round~:(< (index+1),0){y end.
        if. last do. snapshots =. snapshots,<ratings end.
    end.
    (<ratings),(<expected),(<changes),<snapshots
)

sigma =: 3 : '1%1+^-y'
fit_link =: 4 : 0
    alpha =. beta =. 0.0
    for_iteration. i.LinkIterations do.
        g0 =. g1 =. h00 =. h01 =. h11 =. 0.0
        for_index. i.#x do.
            z =. index{x
            result =. index{y
            p =. sigma alpha+beta*z
            w =. p*1-p
            g0 =. g0+result-p
            g1 =. g1+(result-p)*z
            h00 =. h00+w
            h01 =. h01+w*z
            h11 =. h11+(w*z)*z
        end.
        determinant =. (h00*h11)-h01*h01
        alpha =. alpha+((h11*g0)-h01*g1)%determinant
        beta =. beta+((h00*g1)-h01*g0)%determinant
    end.
    alpha,beta
)
log_loss =: 4 : 0
    if. y=2 do. -^.x
    elseif. y=0 do. -^.1-x

)
brier_score =: 4 : '((x-y%2)*(x-y%2))'
correctness =: 4 : 0
    if. y=1 do. 1
    elseif. ((x>0.5)*.y=2)+.(x<0.5)*.y=0 do. 2
    else. 0 end.
)
average_ranks_doubled =: 3 : 0
    result =. 0$0
    for_value. y do.
        greater =. equal =. 0
        for_other. y do.
            comparison =. other frac_compare value
            greater =. greater+comparison>0
            equal =. equal+comparison=0
        end.
        result =. result,(2*greater)+equal+1
    end.
    result
)
kendall_tau =: 4 : 0
    count =. #x
    balance =. 0
    for_t. i.count do.
        for_u. (t+1)+i.count-t+1 do.
            balance =. balance+((t{x)frac_compare u{x)*(t{y)frac_compare u{y
        end.
    end.
    denominator =. (count*(count-1))div 2
    reduced_fraction balance,denominator
)
spearman_rho =: 4 : 0
    first =. average_ranks_doubled x
    second =. average_ranks_doubled y
    squares =. +/*:first-second
    count =. #x
    denominator =. (4*count)*((count*count)-1)
    reduced_fraction (denominator-6*squares),denominator
)

bradley_terry =: 3 : 0
    wins =. TeamCount$0.0
    homewins =. 0.0
    for_match. y do.
        home =. 1{match
        away =. 2{match
        result =. (match_result match)%2
        wins =. ((home{wins)+result)home}wins
        wins =. ((away{wins)+1-result)away}wins
        homewins =. homewins+result
    end.
    strengths =. TeamCount$1.0
    theta =. 1.0
    for_iteration. i.BtIterations do.
        zeta =. TeamCount$0.0
        for_match. y do.
            home =. 1{match
            away =. 2{match
            denominator =. (theta*home{strengths)+away{strengths
            zeta =. ((home{zeta)+theta%denominator)home}zeta
            zeta =. ((away{zeta)+1%denominator)away}zeta
        end.
        strengths =. wins%zeta
        total =. sequential_sum strengths
        strengths =. (strengths*TeamCount)%total
        denominator =. 0.0
        for_match. y do.
            home =. (1{match){strengths
            away =. (2{match){strengths
            denominator =. denominator+home%(theta*home)+away
        end.
        theta =. homewins%denominator
    end.
    (<strengths),<theta
)
offense_defense =: 3 : 0
    points =. (TeamCount,TeamCount)$0
    for_match. y do.
        'round home away first second' =. match
        points =. (((<home,away){points)+second)(<home,away)}points
        points =. (((<away,home){points)+first)(<away,home)}points
    end.
    offense =. TeamCount$0.0
    defense =. TeamCount$1.0
    for_iteration. i.OdIterations do.
        for_j. i.TeamCount do.
            total =. 0.0
            for_i. i.TeamCount do. total =. total+((<i,j){points)%i{defense end.
            offense =. total j}offense
        end.
        for_i. i.TeamCount do.
            total =. 0.0
            for_j. i.TeamCount do. total =. total+((<i,j){points)%j{offense end.
            defense =. total i}defense
        end.
    end.
    (<offense),(<defense),<offense%defense
)

cholesky_solve =: 4 : 0
    count =. #y
    lower =. (count,count)$0.0
    for_i. i.count do.
        for_j. i.i+1 do.
            total =. 0.0
            for_k. i.j do. total =. total+((<i,k){lower)*(<j,k){lower end.
            if. i=j do. value =. %:((<i,i){x)-total
            else. value =. (((<i,j){x)-total)%(<j,j){lower end.
            lower =. value (<i,j)}lower
        end.
    end.
    forward =. result =. count$0.0
    for_i. i.count do.
        total =. 0.0
        for_k. i.i do. total =. total+((<i,k){lower)*k{forward end.
        forward =. (((i{y)-total)%(<i,i){lower)i}forward
    end.
    for_i. |.i.count do.
        total =. 0.0
        for_k. (i+1)+i.count-i+1 do. total =. total+((<k,i){lower)*k{result end.
        result =. (((i{forward)-total)%(<i,i){lower)i}result
    end.
    result
)
gaussian_solve =: 4 : 0
    count =. #y
    for_k. i.count do.
        pivot =. k
        for_row. (k+1)+i.count-k+1 do.
            if. (|(<row,k){x)>|(<pivot,k){x do. pivot =. row end.
        end.
        oldrow =. k{x
        x =. (pivot{x)k}x
        x =. oldrow pivot}x
        oldvalue =. k{y
        y =. (pivot{y)k}y
        y =. oldvalue pivot}y
        for_i. (k+1)+i.count-k+1 do.
            factor =. ((<i,k){x)%(<k,k){x
            for_j. k+i.count-k do. x =. (((<i,j){x)-factor*(<k,j){x)(<i,j)}x end.
            y =. ((i{y)-factor*k{y)i}y
        end.
    end.
    result =. count$0.0
    for_i. |.i.count do.
        total =. 0.0
        for_j. (i+1)+i.count-i+1 do. total =. total+((<i,j){x)*j{result end.
        result =. (((i{y)-total)%(<i,i){x)i}result
    end.
    result
)
colley_ratings =: 3 : 0
    matrix =. (TeamCount,TeamCount)$0.0
    balance =. TeamCount$0
    for_team. i.TeamCount do. matrix =. 2.0 (<team,team)}matrix end.
    for_match. y do.
        'round home away first second' =. match
        matrix =. (1+(<home,home){matrix)(<home,home)}matrix
        matrix =. (1+(<away,away){matrix)(<away,away)}matrix
        matrix =. (((<home,away){matrix)-1)(<home,away)}matrix
        matrix =. (((<away,home){matrix)-1)(<away,home)}matrix
        direction =. *first-second
        balance =. ((home{balance)+direction)home}balance
        balance =. ((away{balance)-direction)away}balance
    end.
    matrix cholesky_solve 1+balance%2
)
massey_ratings =: 3 : 0
    count =. TeamCount+1
    matrix =. (count,count)$0.0
    vector =. count$0.0
    for_match. y do.
        'round home away first second' =. match
        margin =. first-second
        positive =. 5 2$(home,home),(away,away),(home,TeamCount),(TeamCount,home),TeamCount,TeamCount
        for_pair. positive do.
            matrix =. (1+(<pair){matrix)(<pair)}matrix
        end.
        negative =. 4 2$(home,away),(away,home),(away,TeamCount),TeamCount,away
        for_pair. negative do.
            matrix =. (((<pair){matrix)-1)(<pair)}matrix
        end.
        vector =. ((home{vector)+margin)home}vector
        vector =. ((away{vector)-margin)away}vector
        vector =. ((TeamCount{vector)+margin)TeamCount}vector
    end.
    matrix =. ((TeamCount$1.0),0.0)(TeamCount-1)}matrix
    vector =. 0.0 (TeamCount-1)}vector
    solution =. matrix gaussian_solve vector
    (<TeamCount{.solution),<{:solution
)

team_records =: 3 : 0
    records =. (TeamCount,8)$0
    for_match. y do.
        'round home away first second' =. match
        for_side. 0 1 do.
            if. side=0 do. team =. home
                scored =. first
                conceded =. second
            else. team =. away
                scored =. second
                conceded =. first end.
            row =. team{records
            row =. (1+0{row)0}row
            row =. (scored+4{row)4}row
            row =. (conceded+5{row)5}row
            if. scored>conceded do. row =. (1+1{row)1}row
                row =. (WinPoints+6{row)6}row
            elseif. scored=conceded do. row =. (1+2{row)2}row
                row =. (DrawPoints+6{row)6}row
            else. row =. (1+3{row)3}row end.
            row =. ((4{row)-5{row)7}row
            records =. row team}records
        end.
    end.
    records
)
